clips.title: The story
paras: Boulderslide kobolds dig deep in Boulderslide Cavern, at the far end of Boulderslide Ravine. They search the stone for glowing mineral formations.

Boulderslide kobolds have carved a stronghold into the Stonetalon crags. They dig frantically for resonite, a rare purple crystal embedded in the stone. Its glow carries traces of earthen magic, and the kobolds turn fiercely against anyone who approaches their excavation.
